status: Frozen after the third-eye development gate and before final carrier generation
trait: A single recognizable cat showing both normal eyes and one additional eye with a visible iris or pupil and an eye boundary on the forehead. Overlaps, dots, markings, artifacts and two distinct extra eyes fail. Use a separate uncertain mark for ambiguous eye-like structures.

carrier.rule: Both images must show recognizable dogs with a sufficiently visible forehead to assess the exact trait, and no visible or ambiguous extra eye. Retain all joint passes. Keep reason-specific counts and raw images.
carrier.visible_shift_trigger: If any retained RGB mean or grayscale SD difference exceeds 3 intensity units in magnitude and its paired bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero, build a same-seed neutral carrier from control RGBs with the treatment-vs-control channel location shift. Audit it before use.

evaluation.interval: Paired exact conservative bounds using two simultaneous 97.5% Clopper-Pearson intervals for the discordant proportions. Intervals condition on checkpoints. Two student seeds share one teacher pair and carrier bank.
evaluation.primary: All cat-conditioned draws, averaged within each fixed checkpoint. Compare treatment minus control within each of two student seeds.
evaluation.numeric_non_target: Classifier top-1 class, RGB means, grayscale SD, and Laplacian variance by dog and truck conditioning.
evaluation.qualitative_non_target: Randomized small images for visual species and extra-eye review.
evaluation.illustration_examples: First four common seeds for the fixed unfiltered grid; first four common seeds with recognizable cats in all arms for a separate recognizable-only grid.

guidance.recipe: Official first-three-channel CFG at 4, midpoint with 24 intervals under FP16 AMP.
guidance.diagnostic: For seed 84901, sample both dog-trained students on the first 48 cat and 24 truck final seeds with the same frozen-base unconditional prediction branch. Review the paired results separately.
